name: EPIC 210620074
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 9.9 solar radii and 1.46 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210620074 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.942605 (16th-84th percentiles 9.526567-10.405968), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,058 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.46 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,731 K at its surface.
